$comment: Macro facts about digital economies. Scouted 2026-10-25 by a read-only research agent (page reads and API calls via WebFetch); chain count, top chains and top fee protocols re-measured by script against api.llama.fi at measuredAt. Values are as the source returned them; nothing here is an estimate.

facts.claim: Netcraft's July 2026 Web Server Survey received responses from 1,494,915,628 sites across 305,348,459 domains and 14,772,048 web-facing computers
facts.method: page read (WebFetch). August, September and October 2026 survey URLs returned 404, so July is the latest found

facts.claim: Domains in Netcraft's July 2026 survey
facts.method: page read (WebFetch). The page gives no overall active-site total, so none is reported here

facts.claim: 401.6 million domain name registrations across all TLDs at the end of Q2 2026
facts.method: page read (WebFetch) of the Verisign blog. Q3 2026 brief not found

facts.claim: .com base 166.6 million and .net 12.5 million registrations at the end of Q2 2026
facts.method: web search summary of the Verisign IR release. A direct fetch got HTTP 403

facts.claim: WordPress is used by 39.6% of all websites, a 58.3% share of the CMS market
facts.method: page read (WebFetch)

facts.claim: Shopify is used by 5.3% of all websites, a 7.9% share of the CMS market
facts.method: page read (WebFetch)

facts.claim: 32.1% of websites use no CMS that W3Techs detects
facts.method: page read (WebFetch)

facts.claim: Shopify does not publish an exact store or merchant count. Its official wording is 'millions of merchants' in 175+ countries
facts.method: web search. No primary exact figure was found, and third-party counts are left out

facts.claim: DefiLlama's chains endpoint lists 421 chains
facts.method: API call GET https://api.llama.fi/v2/chains via WebFetch. Counted twice by the fetch model (a hand tally, then an enumerated name list 1..421), not by a script, because the shell was blocked; re-counted by script (array length) at 2026-10-25T17:06:01.773Z

facts.claim: Total DeFi TVL across all chains: $88,834,030,174
facts.method: API call GET https://api.llama.fi/v2/historicalChainTvl, last array element. The previous day (1792800000) was 89,627,407,049

facts.claim: Total circulating USD-pegged stablecoins: $302,616,607,151.24. EUR-pegged adds $836,842,250.78
facts.method: API call GET https://stablecoins.llama.fi/stablecoincharts/all, last element, totalCirculatingUSD.peggedUSD. defillama.com/stablecoins returned 403

facts.claim: Fees across all protocols tracked in DefiLlama's fees overview: $2,321,715,312 over 30 days and $23,660,789,302 over 1 year. The 30-day total is -14.02% against the prior 30 days
facts.method: API call to the endpoint shown. Top-level total30d, total1y and change_30dover30d fields

facts.claim: x402 is an open standard from Coinbase that lets clients and servers make payments inside normal HTTP communication, using HTTP 402 Payment Required
facts.method: page read (WebFetch)

facts.claim: x402.org reports 75.41M transactions, $24.24M volume, 94.06K buyers and 22K sellers over the last 30 days
facts.method: page read (WebFetch). Coinbase's 160M+ 'last year' figure is a CEO social-media claim and its Q1 2026 deck figure came from secondary coverage, so neither is included

facts.claim: The Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) is an open standard co-developed by Stripe and OpenAI. It launched with Instant Checkout in ChatGPT and uses Stripe Shared Payment Tokens scoped to a merchant and basket total
facts.method: web search of the Stripe newsroom release

facts.claim: Google's Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) is an open protocol for agent-led payments that extends A2A and MCP. It uses Verifiable Credential 'mandates' (Intent, Cart, Payment) and launched with 60+ partners
facts.method: web search. Only the Japanese edition of the Google Cloud blog surfaced; the English URL follows the same slug

facts.claim: Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol is part of Visa Intelligent Commerce. It helps merchants tell trusted AI agents from bots using HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421)
facts.method: web search (Visa developer page plus a partner release)

facts.claim: Mastercard Agent Pay launched on 2025-04-29 with Mastercard Agentic Tokens and registration and verification of trusted AI agents. Microsoft is the lead AI partner
facts.method: web search of the Mastercard newsroom release

facts.claim: Goldman Sachs Research (Eric Sheridan) projects the creator economy TAM to reach about $480B by 2027, up from about $250B, with about 50M creators of whom about 4% are professionals earning over $100k a year
facts.method: web search of the Goldman Sachs insights page

facts.claim: Newzoo forecasts the global games market at $213.9B in 2026 (+6.1% YoY): mobile $121.1B, console $46.9B, PC $45.9B, with 3.7B players
facts.asOf: 2026-09 (report coverage dated 2026-09-11; preliminary figures shown at Gamescom 2026-08)
facts.method: page read of secondary coverage of the Newzoo 2026 Global Games Market Report. A newzoo.com primary page was not found

facts.claim: Anthropic stated its run-rate revenue crossed $47 billion in May 2026, in its Series H announcement.
facts.method: web search restricted to anthropic.com. A reported $65B run-rate (Bloomberg, end of July 2026) is press-sourced and left out

facts.claim: Hugging Face Hub lists 3,186,261 models
facts.method: page read (WebFetch) of the 'Models N' counter

facts.claim: Hugging Face Hub lists 1,105,509 datasets
facts.method: page read (WebFetch) of the 'Datasets N' counter
